articles.title: Semantic diffing of formal policies with anti-unification
articles.author: Ferhat Erata
articles.summary: When reviewing code, you start with a diff. You wouldn’t compare two 3,000-line files by eye and hope to spot every change. Formal policies can be even harder to compare because a textual diff often highlights syntactic changes that don’t affect meaning. Reorder two conjuncts, swap the arguments of an equality, or use an equivalent predicate, and much of the file might appear changed. A real change in behavior, such as an Or where the requirement says and, can get lost in that noise. A semantic diff shows what two policies have in common and where they disagree. The open source engine used in this post computes this diff using anti-unification, which finds a most specific common pattern for two expressions. articles.title: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
articles.author: Siddharth Senger
articles.summary: Silent data corruption (SDC) happens when hardware, such as a GPU, returns a wrong but plausible number and raises no error. In distributed training, the wrong number can flow into the gradients and weights of every replica. Loss can still look normal for hours, and by the time a team notices an unexplained divergence or a weaker model, the compute is spent. It happens at scale: during a 54-day period of Llama 3 405B pre-training on up to 16K H100 GPUs, Meta attributed 6 of 419 unexpected job interruptions to silent data corruption, and those were only the cases that interrupted the job and were traced to SDC. Amazon SageMaker HyperPod already replaces nodes that report a fault: the health-monitoring agent watches for GPU errors, deep health checks stress-test nodes, and automatic node...

articles.summary: Every day, Zillow sends home shoppers more than 100 million personalized email and push notifications: saved search alerts, home recommendations, property updates, seller reports, and reminders. articles.author: AI Engineer
articles.summary: 💾Coding agents made writing code almost free, but maintaining it didn't get any cheaper. Dmitry Buykin shares what happens months in, once agents write most of a large production codebase: tests that pass while production breaks, work nobody asked for, rules that contradict each other, and sprawl no one can review. He covers the patterns that actually help, from replaying real tasks and expert-owned evals to runtime guardrails and weekly pruning, and closes with an 18-question checklist for auditing your own AI-coded repo. articles.title: Use Grok Bot Better Than 99% of People (Full Course)
articles.author: Greg Isenberg
articles.summary: 💾I sit down with Ras Mic to see how he runs his work and his life through Grok Bot. He calls himself a Grok Bot maxi, and he uses it as a personal agent and as an orchestrator that hands engineering work to Claude Code. He walks me through five areas: engineering, design, content ideation, business and finance, and shopping. articles.summary: Release: llm 0.37.2 Fixes a security issue reported by Daniel de Araujo in GHSA-v9h7-jj4g-f862 and GHSA-r639-rr7r-x72w. LLM has a mechanism called extra-openai-models.yaml - now managed by the new-in-0.37 llm openai endpoint add command - for using LLM with OpenAI-compatible API endpoints from other providers. Daniel reported two ways this could accidentally send your configured OpenAI API key to one of those providers: if the key named by api_key_name had never been stored, or if a responses: true model was run with -o chat_completions 1. articles.summary: 原创 酸梅干超人 2026-11-11 22:34 上海 相信很多同学现在都听过一个词叫 “AI味”，即使用 VibeCoding 生成出来的界面一看就是 AI 做出来的塑料质感，毫无特色，如果要作为正式设计产物的话显然是不合格的。所以今天的主题，就要解释 VibeCoding 中的 AI 味究竟是什么。AI味儿的正确定义当我们进行 VibeCoding 开发程序时，AI会自己完成前端界面样式的设计并开发出来。而这个界面的样式就是 AI 味的来源。虽然我们能识别 AI 味，但很难讲清楚什么才叫AI味，如果不能清晰定义它的特征，你也就不知道应该怎么优化它。所以下面我们把AI做的前端界面设计问题做个总结：问题1：规范错误第一个问题就是规范问题，比如顶部状态栏、底部导航栏的尺寸位置是错的，或使用的字体、字号不对，按钮的尺寸不符合移动端的标准等等。AI 设计移动端界面是以网页设计的标准模拟出来的，并没有把相关规范准确应用进去，如果没在提示词中进行严格的指定，那么设计出来的结果就只是 “看起来像APP”的响应式网页而已。问题2：圆角泛滥第二个问题就是圆角问题，桌面端网页做圆角因为画布大造成的问题就比较小，但在移动端屏幕中，圆角的感知是被放大的。如果出现了很多大圆角，且圆角各不相同，对视觉的负面影响就会加大。问题3：字体滥用第三个字体问题也很突出，移动端设计不是不能用别的字体，但通常会很克制，只在必要的情况下使用。而AI生成界面时就并没有这种顾虑，表现得非常随意。而这并不是问题的核心痛点，真正的痛点是 AI...

articles.summary: 白鲸出海 2026-11-11 21:30 四川 一场干货密度极高的变现指南。 11 月 5 日上午，在 GTC2026 全球流量大会（上海）分会场，「AI 漫剧沙龙暨短剧资源对接会」如期举行。星云/灵矩科技、Luckyshort、AppsFlyer、新规范片场等产业链核心玩家齐聚一堂，从爆款复盘的台前，到数据归因的幕后，再到百部实战的工业化体系，为现场观众带来了一场干货密度极高的变现指南。全球化视角下，AI短剧的新变化——从人人做短剧，到人人发短剧星云 CEO、灵矩科技联合创始人 吕少龙“8 年的网文出海路，AI 漫剧只用 1 年就走完了。”吕少龙在开场便抛出了这个震撼的观点。作为国内最早一批吃螃蟹的团队，灵矩动漫在 2024 年底遭遇了真人实拍的巨大瓶颈：投流 ROI 跌破 1.1，演员成本激增导致制作成本从部均 30 万涨到 80 万，爆款率却从 20% 跌至 10%。面对“爆款收益无法覆盖扑街成本”的残酷现实，灵矩果断全面转型 AI 短剧。他们经历了试错与快速扩张，首部 AI 作品《咒术反噬》当周充值破百万，第二部《末日壁垒》当周破两百万。但随着人员规模扩大，人效变差的新问题随之而来。为此，吕少龙祭出了两把破局利剑：中台模式与极致标准化。通过将编剧、分镜、美术、抽卡、后期和运营全部中台化，并将全流程拆解为 120 个知识点，灵矩实现了审美与产能的极度标准化，单月最高产能曾达到 2000 部。然而，到了 2026 年，国内红果日活突破 1.62 亿，日上新剧高达 1000- 1500 部，投流周期被极限压缩至 3 天以内。吕少龙直言：“内容工厂模式，或许走不通了。”面对极度内卷，星云平台选择“开辟出海”，打造从“人人做短剧”到“人人发短剧”的全球化内容分发平台。依托全链路赋能、全球化发行以及最高 90%...

几个关键参数：总参数280B，每次推理只激活 14B，支持 1M 长上下文，千帆 API 单用户推理速度 200+ tokens/s，Apac...
articles.author: 向阳乔木 (@vista8)
articles.summary: 百度文心5.5 Flash Preview 今天发布。几个关键参数：总参数280B，每次推理只激活 14B，支持 1M 长上下文，千帆 API 单用户推理速度 200+ tokens/s，Apache 2.0协议开源，支持 SGLang 和 vLLM 部署。编程能力据说提升显著：训练数据用了超过1400万个可执行代码任务，加上多 Agent 框架真实执行轨迹，模型不仅能写代码，还能接管复杂软件工程任务。WebDev、游戏开发、3D仿真、视频编排，描述需求能直出可运行交互。知识工作的训练规模也很大：30万个工作空间、1000万份文件、40余种文件类型，后训练覆盖金融、法律等专业领域。分散的材料扔进去，模型能自主规划任务，调 MCP 工具和Skill，直接交付可用的表格、文档和报告。架构层面做了几件事：混合稀疏注意力解决长上下文 KV Cache 显存占用，多路由器 MoE 加 ECHO 多 Token 预测在提升能力的同时压低计算开销，FP4 专家权重和 草稿头专门针对 Agent 任务提速。280B参数每次仅激活 14B 还能跑到 200 tokens/s 以上，就是得益于上面的构架组合。百度早些时候披露了自动研究系统 ERNIE Evolve，能自主提出研究方向、开展实验、验证结果、积累经验，在NanoChat AutoResearch 和 NanoGPT Speedrun 两项任务三个评测指标上，拿到目前公开验证 SOTA。据说系统已参与了文心 5.5 Flash 的推理优化，包括低时延场景性能优化、确定性推理吞吐优化和极致解码速度优化，用 AI 系统来优化 AI 模型，这就是大家常说的 RSI 吧，加油！Openrouter 能免费用，抽空体验下，看看实际模型质量怎么样。Baidu Inc.@Baidu_IncERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview just...

articles.title: AI Agent 技术全景解析 —— 从提示词工程到高级智能体构建
articles.summary: 原创 互联研发效能团队 2026-11-11 20:00 广东 本文系统梳理了 AI Agent 技术演进全景，核心目标是构建能自主规划、调用工具、交付结果的"数字员工"。 作者：vivo 互联研发效能团队- Wu Qinghua目录01. 背景02. 现实问题03. 理论探索04. 方法设计05. 实践脉络：从知识沉淀到范式开发06. 效果评估与经验教训07. 结论展望本文系统梳理了 AI Agent 技术演进全景，核心目标是构建能自主规划、调用工具、交付结果的"数字员工"。从提示词工程（如何精准传达意图），到 RAG（如何接入外部知识），再到 Harness 工程（如何让模型持续可靠运行），再到 ReAct 循环（如何赋予自主决策与执行能力），最后到多智能体协作。1分钟看图掌握核心要点👇00引言：从"问答工具"到"数字员工"我们熟悉的 AI 交互大家都用过 ChatGPT 或类似的大语言模型。交互方式很简单：你问一个问题，它给一个回答。这种"对话式"交互已经很强大了，但仔细想想，它有三个明显的局限：一次性任务：每次对话都是独立的，它不会主动延续上次的话题缺乏长期记忆：换个窗口，它就把你忘了无法自主执行：它只能"说"，不能"做"——不能帮你查数据库、发邮件、跑测试打个比方：这就像一个博学但没有手脚、也没有记忆的顾问。你每次都得把背景重新交代一遍，他给你建议，但你得自己动手执行。核心问题我们真正想要的是什么？是一个能理解目标、自主规划、并执行复杂任务的"智能代理"——就像一个新员工，你给他一个任务，他会自己拆解步骤、调用工具、遇到问题会调整方案，最终交付结果。这就是 AI Agent 要解决的核心问题。一段简短的历史演进在正式开始之前，让我们快速回顾一下这条技术路线是如何演进过来的——理解历史，能帮我们看清未来：一条主线贯穿始终：从"人写好 prompt 让 LLM...

一年一度百度世界 2026 要召开了！每次都能线下见到好多朋友。

可能是为了迎接会议，百度文心5.5 Flash Preview 今天发布了。

几个关键参数：总参数280B，每次推理只激活 14B...
articles.author: 向阳乔木 (@vista8)
articles.summary: 一年一度百度世界 2026 要召开了！每次都能线下见到好多朋友。可能是为了迎接会议，百度文心5.5 Flash Preview 今天发布了。几个关键参数：总参数280B，每次推理只激活 14B，支持 1M 长上下文，千帆 API 单用户推理速度 200+ tokens/s，Apache 2.0协议开源，支持 SGLang 和 vLLM 部署。编程能力据说提升显著：训练数据用了超过1400万个可执行代码任务，加上多 Agent 框架真实执行轨迹，模型不仅能写代码，还能接管复杂软件工程任务。WebDev、游戏开发、3D仿真、视频编排，描述需求能直出可运行交互。知识工作的训练规模也很大：30万个工作空间、1000万份文件、40余种文件类型，后训练覆盖金融、法律等专业领域。分散的材料扔进去，模型能自主规划任务，调 MCP 工具和Skill，直接交付可用的表格、文档和报告。架构层面做了几件事：混合稀疏注意力解决长上下文 KV Cache 显存占用，多路由器 MoE 加 ECHO 多 Token 预测在提升能力的同时压低计算开销，FP4 专家权重和 草稿头专门针对 Agent 任务提速。280B参数每次仅激活 14B 还能跑到 200 tokens/s 以上，就是得益于上面的构架组合。百度早些时候披露了自动研究系统 ERNIE Evolve，能自主提出研究方向、开展实验、验证结果、积累经验，在NanoChat AutoResearch 和 NanoGPT Speedrun 两项任务三个评测指标上，拿到目前公开验证 SOTA。据说系统已参与了文心 5.5 Flash 的推理优化，包括低时延场景性能优化、确定性推理吞吐优化和极致解码速度优化，用 AI 系统来优化 AI 模型，这就是大家常说的 RSI 吧，加油！Openrouter 能免费用，抽空体验下，看看实际模型质量怎么样。Baidu...

articles.title: 上市半年股价暴跌77%，英伟达“挑战者”Cerebras怎么了？
articles.summary: 原创 硅基君 2026-11-11 19:00 北京 AI芯片明星，撞上商业现实 谁能想到，曾被寄予厚望、号称挑战英伟达的Cerebras，上市仅仅半年，股价就跌去了近八成。2026年5月14日，Cerebras上市首日股价一度冲至386.34美元。而截至11月6日收盘，股价只剩89.68美元，较高点暴跌76.8%。更让人意外的是，Cerebras的业绩并不差。从2025年第四季度到今年第二季度，公司营收同比增速分别达到110.3%、94.4%和74%。虽然增速有所放缓，但仍然保持着较高的增长水平。不过，在这份增长背后，Cerebras的商业模式正在发生一场深刻变化。去年第二季度，Cerebras云及其他服务收入占比只有32%，到今年第二季度已经提升至70%，成为公司最主要的收入来源。与此同时，硬件业务收入却连续两个季度环比下滑。换句话说，曾经靠卖芯片挑战英伟达的Cerebras，如今越来越像一家AI云服务商。这也带来了一个值得思考的问题：一家拥有全球领先推理性能的芯片公司，为什么越来越依赖云服务赚钱？答案可能恰恰藏在Cerebras最引以为傲的技术优势里。Cerebras几乎做到极致的Token生成速度，始终无法转化为同等幅度的商业价值。而转向云服务，虽然降低了客户使用门槛，却也让Cerebras承担起更加沉重的资本投入。当技术优势难以转化为定价权，收入增长又依赖巨额资本投入，投资者自然开始重新审视Cerebras的商业价值。/ 01...

articles.title: Close the Loop：Verification是AI加速物理世界的关键
articles.summary: 原创 Ted Xiao 2026-11-11 18:38 新加坡 局部加速越快，还没有被加速的部分就越容易成为瓶颈 演讲者：Ted Xiao（Prometheus 创始技术成员、前 Google DeepMind 研究员）编译：Haozhen ⁠如果 AGI 和通用机器人都取得成功，一个物质丰富、全人类都能受益的世界，是否就会自然到来？ ⁠Ted Xiao（Prometheus 创始技术成员、前 Google DeepMind 研究员）在 Humanoid Hub Conference 的演讲中，从这个假设出发，分析了新技术从构想到量产的过程：即使智能和劳动能力都变得充裕，哪些环节仍会拖慢研发和生产？又有哪些研究和商业机会值得提前投入？ ⁠在他看来： ⁠•按 Amdahl 定律，如果一半时间花在无法加速的环节，其余工作再快，总耗时也最多减半。 ⁠•Verification 决定模型 post-training 的上限。 ⁠•如果 verifier 有漏洞，模型可能学会利用漏洞拿高分，实际表现不一定变好。 ⁠•Verifier 也要接受检验，遇到历史数据没覆盖的新设计，仍要用实测结果检验它的判断。 ⁠•开发团队要到现场弄清什么算合格，据此设计 verifier，再用有限的实测检验和改进它。 ⁠我们编译了 Ted Xiao 的这场演讲。他谈到的 verification 瓶颈，也正是我们看好 AI for Science、机器人和硬件制造的原因之一。随着 AI 能力的增强，虽然模型可以更快地提出方案，但要知道方案能不能用，往往还得做真实的实验和工程测试，而模型变强很难直接加快这些测试。⁠/⁠01.AGI 和通用机器人都实现后，还缺什么？...

articles.title: 阿里云+自建 IDC 混合运维：一套 AIOps 打通云监控与机房动环，实现跨域根因 RCA
articles.summary: 哒哒AI工具库 2026-11-11 18:00 日本 我是韩先超，51CTO 学堂 K8s、Python 教学总监、AIOps 实战训练营讲师，云计算架构师 我是韩先超，51CTO 学堂 K8s、Python 教学总监、AIOps 实战训练营讲师，云计算架构师，具有 8 年项目实战经验+5 年教学经验，线上学员已达 300w+。很多中大型企业运维现在都卡在一边使用阿里云的公有云、一边自建机房/IDC 的混合架构里。两套体系各自有监控：云上是云监控、ARMS、SLS；机房侧是传统动环、UPS、精密空调、安防监控。两套系统独立告警、独立台账、独立值班，云归云、机房归机房，出了问题经常 “分头查、各自猜”。网上大部分 AIOps 文章，要么只讲纯云上微服务链路 RCA，要么只讲本地机房巡检，很少讲如何用一套 AIOps 平台把阿里云观测数据和传统机房运维数据进行对接、融合、统一研判。本文针对这个差异化场景给出落地实操，包括架构、对接流程、真实故障案例、踩坑、收益等。混合运维的真实痛点：阿里云和机房是两个信息孤岛我们的架构：核心业务跑阿里云 ECS、容器服务用 ACK、RDS；数据库备份、存储、灾备、物理网关、供电制冷放在自建 IDC 机房。之前的现状是：阿里云侧：云监控告警、ARMS 链路、SLS 日志、ACK 容器指标，告警推到一个值班群；机房侧：动环系统采集电压、温湿度、漏水、UPS 状态，单独一套告警推另一个群；运维人员要同时看两套平台、两套告警、两套资产台账。痛点：1. 故障因果割裂机房空调故障 → 机房温度升高 → 阿里云专线接入的物理网关过热丢包 → 云上业务大量超时。故障现象是阿里云 ARMS 疯狂报接口错误、RDS 延迟上涨，但云上监控看不到机房温度、空调状态；机房动环只报空调告警，不知道会影响云上哪些业务。两边告警分开推送，值班人很难第一时间把...

articles.title: 开发者实测｜把视频处理交给 Agent：AI MediaKit Skill 深度评测

articles.title: 4.99 万元起，长安糯玉米 PLUS 变成四门「大玉米」，小车最后还是要「大大大」
articles.author: 陈世琛
articles.summary: 在路上开车，你大概率也被一台长安糯玉米瞪过。 这台圆润小车，在圆形大灯上方做了一截下压的灯眉，自带「战斗脸」成了糯玉米在路上最大的辨识度。 不过放眼到 A00 级微型纯电车市场，糯玉米确实该急眼了。 随着国内车市价格战一路向下挤压，整个 A00 级微型纯电车市场正在经历明显的收缩。乘联会数据显示，今年上半年国内 5 万元以下乘用车销量约 13 万辆，同比下滑 55%，市场份额也从 2.8% 缩水到了 1.4%。 当纯电代步小车的生存空间被越压越窄，糯玉米的直接对手们不约而同地选了同一条路——扩容。 五菱宏光 MINIEV 推出了四门版，一汽奔腾小马也在 10 月底拿出了五门版，并且都在近期迎来了销量反弹。反观一直守着三门四座布局的糯玉米，10 月零售销量环比下滑约 46%，滑落到了 5224 辆。 终于，糯玉米也坐不住了。 11 月 11 日，糯玉米 PLUS 正式上市。新车共推出 4 款配置，上市限时权益价为 4.99 万～5.69 万元，具体来看： 205km 米乐乐（国轩高科电池）：指导价 5.29 万元，限时权益价 4.99 万元 205km 米乐乐（宁德时代电池）：指导价 5.49 万元，限时权益价 5.19 万元 205km 米多多（宁德时代电池）：指导价 5.59 万元，限时权益价 5.29 万元 301km 米多多（宁德时代电池）：指导价 5.99 万元，限时权益价 5.69 万元 全系车型均搭载最大功率 35kW 的前置单电机，并全系标配直流快充功能，电量从 30% 充至 80% 约需 35 分钟。 值得一提的是，2022 年上市时还挂着长安新能源招牌的糯玉米，已经在今年正式并入长安启源的产品序列。 后排落座 糯玉米 PLUS 顾名思义，就是一台多了两扇后车门的糯玉米。...

articles.summary: 兄弟们，好朋友推荐他们最近做的的这个 Mac AI 助手。体验了几天当场被惊艳到，强推给大家，一定体验下！它叫 EnConvo AI。Claude、GPT、Gemini 、DeepSeek等这些模型，全在一个对话里用，换模型不用换 App，不用来回切。写代码、写稿、语音、搜索、做视频，它都能干。我平时做 AI 视频用的 Renoise 插件，一条命令就装进去了，根本都不用来回打开Claude和Codex。Claude Code 里攒的 383 个技能，它直接原地发现，直接我就可以在对话中使用。Opus 天天封号那点事，也不用再折腾了：用它的云端套餐，多种最顶最新的模型，直接就可以干，当然也是真的烧钱啊！我觉得最顺手的地方有这些：微信里看到一句话，选中就能问。屏幕顶上的刘海，能提问，还能看任务跑到哪一步。在x上做了一个推文撰写小助手，直接就可以进行新闻稿转写。还有一堆想不到的：桌宠、打电话、虚拟形象。这些我先不展开，视频里带大家过一遍基础功能，后面两三期慢慢给大家介绍，今天先小露一手。说实话，这是我目前见过功能最全的一个 Mac AI 助手，一个对话里能搞定一堆事，太爽了～官网放评论区，它多端支持 Mac Win iOS 安卓👇Your browser does not support the video tag.🔗 View on Twitter💬19🔄4❤️40👀5145📊33⚡ Powered by xgo.ing

articles.title: 从AI机遇到现实生产力
articles.summary: 原创 王强 2026-11-11 17:40 北京 创造价值，才是永恒的。 王强 腾讯研究院前沿科技研究中心主任在 2026 腾讯全球数字生态大会上，一个变化已经很清楚：大家讨论的不只是模型更强、工具更好用，而是智能如何真正进入千行百业的流程，变成可运营、可进化的现实生产力。两条线的历史性交汇过去几十年的信息技术，改变的主要是信息如何被传递与处理。这一轮不同，当机器开始能够理解意图、拆解任务、调用工具并交付结果，AI 就从对话交互跨入了自主交付。被改变的不再只是信息的流动，而是工作本身如何被完成。这件事的量级不仅在工具层面，更在生产和组织方式层面。这一轮变革之所以对中国格外重要，是因为两条原本各自演进的曲线，正在同一个时间点交汇。一条是技术的曲线。基础大模型从可用迈向好用，第一次达到可以进入各行各业生产流程的水平。另一条是产业的曲线。中国制造、能源、零售、物流、金融等产业规模全球第一，正处在从规模走向质量的关口上，内生的升级需求前所未有地强烈。各行业设备不缺，产能不缺，缺的是把数据与经验变成高效运营、高水平决策的能力。技术的供给与产业的需求，正在双向奔赴。国家战略对这一交汇作出了回应，提出深化拓展“人工智能+”，赋能经济社会发展和治理能力提升，促进生产方式的深层次变革和生产力革命性跃迁。回望历史，技术的演进与市场的使用往往是两件先后发生的事，且间隔时间很长。但这次变革不同，智能的进化依赖真实任务的反馈，用户使用场景直接参与大模型能力的提升。也就是说，需求侧第一次成为供给侧的一部分。我国庞大的用户基数、完整的产业门类、深厚的数字化底座、充足的工程人才，恰好变成了这一轮技术演进最需要的土壤。但交汇只提供可能，还不等于必然的结果。高盛预测，到 2028 年全球 AI 投资将占全球 GDP 的...

articles.author: Dominique Rolink
articles.summary: As agents write more code, individual productivity goes up, but the bottleneck moves to review. 49% of developers now spend four or more hours a week reviewing AI output and correcting prompts (Atlassian State of Developer Experience Report 2026). We believe this means you need to understand what changed, decide whether it belongs in your codebase, and be able to maintain it after the session ends. This is why we shipped Air in JetBrains IDEs, with the 2026.3 release. This allows you to bring your coding agents into your existing development environment, with one place to track their progress, review their changes, and send feedback. articles.title: 一座短剧之都的魔幻一年
articles.summary: 原创 值得关注的 2026-11-11 16:02 北京 “泡沫没有吹在我们身上” 走进AI改变的城市与产业，记录技术浪潮之下，财富的流动与人的沉浮。本篇为《AI进城》第01篇，我们来到郑州，回看一座短剧之城遭遇转折的一年。在AI改变内容生产方式的同时，平台、公司和普通从业者将面临怎样的命运？文｜顾翎羽编辑｜徐青阳2026年秋天，郑州一家AI内容制作公司——禄明映画的老板莹姐要处理几件事：把团队缩到70人，裁掉几名导演，减少自制项目，还要重新寻找公司接下来的收入来源。半年前，她发愁的却要简单得多：招不到人。4月，AI短剧刚刚起量，市场上懂生成工具的人很少，她的团队很快做出一部播放量过亿的AI仿真人短剧，公司最多时扩张到120人。变化来得很快。到了七八月，莹姐发现，自己越来越难判断一部AI短剧能不能赚钱。一部系列剧的第一部获得1800多万播放、约20万收藏，收入接近30万元。她沿用相近的制作标准做了第二部，剧本、剪辑和算力都没有降级，最终却只获得七八万播放，收入300多元。同一个系列，两部作品的收入相差近千倍。“崩坏了，我们经常说崩坏了，不知道怎么弄了。”莹姐说。她告诉我，其公司所在的AI园区里，年初以来陆续有了20多家AI短剧公司，到目前她知道的，就有5家撑不下去了。这和市场需求恰恰相反。AI短剧正在以惊人的速度增加。DataEye研究院估算，2025年国内漫剧用户规模约1.2亿，到2026年上半年，AI剧漫剧用户规模已经突破6亿。AI短剧的生产门槛正在迅速降低，流量和收入却并没有跟着变得容易获取。DataEye数据显示，上半年抖音端AI漫剧播放量破亿的作品不到千分之五，达到盈亏平衡参考线的只有1.3%，换句话说，平均每77部新剧，只有1部能够达到这一参考线。11...

articles.summary: 原创 阿颖 2026-11-11 15:19 北京 可能很多人都没注意到，月初，美团发布了新的 LLM 模型 LongCat-2.5，然后这周又正式开放权重。昨天晚上，和同学聚会。有个哥们在美团外卖的业务当程序员。他说，美团的这个模型，真的是在没人注意的角落里，慢慢追了上来。虽然整体能力距离全球最头部的几个模型还有差距，但已经相当不错了。我看了一下官方的 Benchmark，他们拿 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的上一代模型，比如 GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5 做对比，LongCat-2.5 已经能够接近这些模型的水平，部分指标甚至还要高一些。当然肯定不是说这个模型已经能够到达 5.6 Sol 这样的水准，国产模型的爬坡还是需要一段时间。尤其是 LongCat 训练全部用的是国产芯片.......其实最打动我的不是和其他模型对比。大家看看下面这个截图，深绿色是 LongCat-2.0，浅绿色是 LongCat-2.5。可以明显看到，短短一代模型，进步非常明显。确实，美团慢慢追上来。加速度还可以。姚顺雨之前说过，今天做大模型从某种程度来说比较 Trivial 的事情，没什么秘密。本质就是把基础设施、数据和评测做好。至于算法，反倒相对简单。美团模型的进步，我觉得也很好说明了这一点。另外，最近经常刷到一些自媒体吐槽，说国外就两三家公司做大模型，为什么国内这么多公司都在做？这个问题本身就问错了。#01为什么美团要自研模型？因为我们生活在国内，所以国内哪家公司发布了新模型，很容易就会注意到。但国外很多模型公司的进展，大家可能根本不知道。除了 OpenAI、Anthropic、Grok 和谷歌，亚马逊、微软、IBM、英伟达、Meta 等等公司，也都在研发自己的模型。我查了一下斯坦福大学今年发布的 AI Index 报告。2025 年，美国发布了 59 个...

articles.author: Daniel Curtis
articles.summary: The Angular team has introduced ngp, a compiler preprocessor that rewrites the analysis stage in Rust using Oxc. articles.title: GitHub新规：闲置仓库将取消安全漏洞提醒
articles.summary: 稀土掘金技术社区 2026-11-11 14:50 四川 11 月 10 日，GitHub 宣布，从 2026 年 12 月 8 日起，将自动暂停过去一年没有活动的大部分代码仓库的 Dependabot 安全漏洞提醒。Dependabot 是 GitHub 自带的依赖安全检测工具。当项目使用的第三方软件包出现已知漏洞时，它会主动向开发者发出警告，提醒及时升级。 这次调整意味着：如果一个仓库连续一年没有推送代码，GitHub 就可能认为它已经不再活跃，并自动关闭该仓库的 Dependabot Alerts。不过，历史漏洞记录不会被删除，而是转为归档状态。开发者重新推送代码，或者在仓库设置中手动开启提醒，就能恢复。以下几类用户需要注意：1. 普通开发者：老项目可能失去安全提醒如果你有一些很久没更新的个人项目，可能会受到影响。即使项目还保存在 GitHub 上，一旦一年没有代码推送，Dependabot 就可能停止提醒你新的依赖漏洞。2. 开源项目维护者：停止更新不代表没有安全风险一些开源项目虽然已经很久没有迭代，但依然有用户在使用。如果安全提醒被暂停，项目依赖出现新漏洞时，维护者可能无法及时收到通知，进而影响下游使用者。3. 企业开发团队：需要重新检查历史仓库企业通常有大量历史项目，其中一些虽然不再频繁更新，却仍在生产环境运行。团队需要排查这些仓库，避免因为停止代码提交而出现安全监控盲区。如果项目仍然需要安全监控，可以重新推送代码，或者在仓库设置中手动开启 Dependabot Alerts。企业也可以通过强制安全配置，避免让符合条件的仓库失去安全提醒。需要注意，这次调整适用于 GitHub.com 和 GitHub Enterprise Cloud，不涉及 GitHub Enterprise...

articles.summary: 原创 十字路口 2026-11-11 14:17 北京 让 Agent，在业务里长出来。👦🏻 编辑: 十字路口🧑‍🎨 排版: NCon“企业落地 Agent 最大的问题，不是模型不够强，而是断点太多。”10 月 29 日，腾讯全球数字生态大会上，腾讯集团高级执行副总裁、云与智慧产业事业群 CEO 汤道生开场便指出这个问题。今天，Agent 正在成为新的生产力形态。员工用 AI 提效已经步入轨道，但企业 AI 落地却存在明显的 Gap。层出不穷的 AI 新功能到底怎么用？员工已经在用 Agent 做产出，每个人走得更快了，但彼此之间的协作并没有提效，怎样成为一个 AI 赋能的组织？能不能从“超级个体”发展到“超级组织”？这些都是过去一年中，市场问得最多的几个问题。还有腾讯员工注意到这个微妙变化：最早大家会在个性签名里放一个和自己有关的文档，让同事们优先读它、方便工作推进；但今年放的不再是文档了，而是一个机器人——有什么事、先问这个机器人。AI 正在从个人提效的工具，走向工作协作的入口。入口变了，但背后的资产、权限、上下文，仍然处在分散的孤岛上。企业如何用 AI 做更准的决策、更快的执行？如何把人、工具、系统和数据连起来，让大模型理解业务上下文，真正进入工作流程？这是本次腾讯数字生态大会在回答的问题。建立 Agent 生产力系统本次腾讯数字生态大会，腾讯给出的解决方案是：围绕“办公协同、数据管理与业务执行”三大场景，持续开放 WorkBuddy Agent 平台能力，打造“全场景、高效能、更放心”的 Agent 生产力系统，帮助企业建设可运营、可进化的智能生产力。会上，以 WorkBuddy 为工作台的一体化套件 Buddy One 正式发布。WorkBuddy 企业版以统一账号、统一积分、统一存储把腾讯办公产品连成套件，腾讯文档、腾讯网盘、ima...

articles.summary: 斯坦福 CS329Z 课程资料公开：讲座每天上 YouTube，两份作业开源，第一份教你花几美元从零写个“Claude Code”斯坦福新课 CS329Z“AI agent 工程”（Engineering AI Agents）开始对外公开全部课程资料。授课老师之一 Michael Ryan 11 月 10 日发帖说，讲座视频每天在 Stanford Online 的 YouTube 频道上一讲，两份作业的代码仓库也放到了 GitHub，都用 MIT 协议，别的学校注明出处就能拿去上课。开课时情况不一样。课程页写的是录像只放在斯坦福内部的 Canvas 平台给选课学生看，校外的人只能下载课件。现在官方频道已经上了第 1 讲《什么是 agent 系统》和第 2 讲《写给 agent 开发者的大模型知识》，第 1 讲播放量过了 9 万。课程主页的课表也开始在每节课旁边挂视频链接。【第一份作业：自己写一个 agent harness】harness 是包在模型外面的那层程序：告诉模型有哪些工具、解析它的回复、替它执行命令、管理上下文。Claude Code、Codex 都可以看成一个模型加一个 harness。作业不许用任何 agent 框架，课程只给一个最原始的接口：传进一串消息，返回一段文字，没有工具调用，也没有结构化输出，其余全靠自己写。前半部分做几条固定流程：给邮件判断优先级、生成每日摘要、手写 BM25 检索（一种按关键词打分的经典搜索算法），再在一份真实企业的邮件档案里做多跳问答。后半部分给一家虚构的能源公司做内部助理：自己设计工具调用格式，接入文档检索，给它一个带沙盒限制的终端，对话太长时压缩上下文，跨会话记住用户的事，执行操作前让用户批准或否决。最后由大模型扮演的“模拟用户”跟你的 agent...

articles.title: 重温《苦涩的教训》：Sutton 还在思考新方法
articles.summary: 原创 NLPer 2026-11-11 13:19 江苏 七年过去回头看 前几天看到 Richard Sutton 发的一条帖子：2019年3月13日，Sutton 写下《The Bitter Lesson》，后来常被概括成“大力出奇迹”。七年多过去，他还在思考“新方法”。Sutton 是现代强化学习的奠基者之一，任教于加拿大阿尔伯塔大学，也是阿尔伯塔机器智能研究所 Amii 的首席科学顾问。他与长期合作者 Andrew Barto 从20世纪80年代起，参与建立了强化学习的概念和算法基础，时间差分学习是其中的重要贡献。两人1998年合著的《Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction》，至今仍是这个领域的经典教材。2025年，ACM 宣布将2024年度图灵奖授予两人，表彰的正是他们为强化学习奠定的基础。他也一直在研究一线。2017年，Sutton 参与创办 DeepMind 在阿尔伯塔的研究团队；2023年，他与 John Carmack 的 Keen Technologies 合作，继续研究通用人工智能。AlphaGo 背后的主要研究者 David Silver，曾是他的博士生。到2025年，两人又共同撰写《Welcome to the Era of Experience》，讨论 AI 怎样从与环境的持续交互中学习，而不只依赖人类已有的数据。他与 Michael Bowling、Patrick M. Pilarski 在2022年共同提出的《阿尔伯塔人工智能研究计划》。他们想构建长期运行的 Agent，在与环境的交互中持续学习，并用学到的世界模型规划下一步。学习不只发生在预先划好的训练期，而要伴随 Agent 的整个运行过程。计划也直接引用了《苦涩的教训》，把可随计算扩展的方法作为研究重点。按照这个计划，Sutton 团队...

Imtiaz (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering; Clarkson University; Potsdam; NY 13699; USA)
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13258v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Audio deepfake detectors that work well on clean lab recordings often degrade after telephone or platform compression. This paper asks a specific question: which low-dimensional acoustic descriptors stay informative after codec degradation? We screen 36 utterance-level features(formants, PNCCs, LFCCs, prosody) on ASVspoof 2019 data and test on the official ASVspoof 2021 LA set across seven codec conditions. Of 33 statistically significant descriptors, only four show large practical separation (|r| >0.5, bootstrap 95% CIs), all first-formant (F1) measures, highly redundant (PC1: 79% variance). The payoff is stability: the 36-feature SVM degrades 14 pp under codec mismatch (9.5%-23.5% EER), while the four-feature RBF-SVM degrades only 5.9...

Joint modeling has demonstrated the value of combining musical descriptions, but existing resources differ in joint coverage and expert verification across dimensions, constraining detailed joint supervision and the analysis of relationships on the same recordings. To support multitask modeling and the study of relationships among musical dimensions in popular music, we introduce FaiSonic Multidimensional Music Dataset (FaiSonic MMD), containing 500 songs totaling approximately 32.86 hours, comprising 250 Chinese-language and 250 English-language songs. articles.author: Yichen Wang; Charles Patrick Martin; David Gunawan; David Cooper
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Musical AI systems behave in non-linear, dynamic ways that exceed the tool-oriented framings inherited from earlier instrument design. Existing frames of control and ensemble interaction do not articulate the entangled, relational agency that emerges when performers work with AI feedback instruments over time. We examine a duet practice with two AI-enabled feedback instruments, S\`u and Agentier, in which feedback operates at the inner level of the AI's recurrent processes and the outer loop of musical interaction between performer, instrument, and co-performer. articles.author: Boyan Han; Xiaoyan Wang; Zhe Sun; Ziqi Wang; Yujun Cai; Hongli Cao; Yiwei Wang; Ming-Hsuan Yang; Liang An
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Answering spatial questions about multi-source scenes requires a model both to identify each sound and to locate it. Existing spatial audio-language models obtain spatial information from a dedicated encoder, which separates spatial and semantic processing into distinct feature spaces. We study whether a general-audio codec trained without spatial supervision can serve both purposes. A controlled layer-wise analysis shows that the frozen codec retains spatial information, with lateral cues carried by the difference between the two ear channels. This information, however, is not readily accessible: in dual-source scenes, a model trained on these features predicts left/right at chance and, on the remaining axes, assigns the detected direction...

articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Music editing transforms existing recordings while preserving their original attributes. Recent approaches adapt pretrained text-to-music models for tasks like inpainting, event insertion, or restoration by conditioning them with context audio. It was recently proposed for image editing to unify generation and editing by treating the source image as in-context information. However, applying this directly to music is computationally expensive due to long audio sequences. In this work, we develop MusicFlux, a text-guided music editor built on an efficient pretrained flow-matching text-to-audio model. articles.author: Marvin Seegert; Richard Taupitz; Korbinian Moller; Johannes Betz
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Microphones let an autonomous vehicle sense into areas its cameras and LiDAR cannot see, by picking up the sound that other traffic participants emit. Locating those sources and fusing them with the visual perception requires the microphone array to be calibrated and registered relative to the vehicle's other sensors. Existing calibration methods assume small, unobstructed indoor rigs, whereas a vehicle body casts an acoustic shadow that straight-line propagation cannot represent, and to our knowledge no calibration of an array distributed around a vehicle has been reported. We propose a pipeline that uses a balloon burst as a single cross-modal target, which the LiDAR locates in metric coordinates, every microphone hears as a sharp onset...

articles.author: Lucas de Souza Brand\~ao; Gabriel da Costa Merlin; Diego Furtado Silva
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14415v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Audio foundation models like CLAP, MuQ, and MERT excel at capturing general musical similarity. On the other hand, their entangled latent spaces limit interpretability and fine-grained attribute control. Conditional Similarity Networks (CSN) address this by pairing a backbone representation model with learned masks that gate the embedding space into attribute-specific subspaces. However, existing methods train the backbone from scratch, rather than leveraging pretrained foundation models. We instead present a systematic study of post-hoc disentanglement, adapting CSN to gate frozen pretrained embeddings. We evaluate adding trainable parameters to adapt the embedding under different masking and pooling regimes across two datasets. Our...

articles.title: Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters
articles.author: Sahil Mahendrakar
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. articles.author: Lucas de Souza Brand\~ao; Lucas Gris; Joaquim Cavalcante; Chukwuemeka Nkama; Andrea Poltronieri
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14443v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) relies on paired audio--MIDI datasets, implicitly assuming near-perfect temporal alignment. However, widely used piano datasets have been shown to contain alignment errors that may bias model evaluation and training. We propose a framework for evaluating audio--MIDI alignment scoring methods through controlled temporal, pitch, and structural MIDI corruptions. We also introduce STI, a scoring method built on AMT models, and benchmark it against existing alignment scoring approaches. Our results show that STI, together with methods based on CENS and spectrograms, achieves the strongest overall performance, with STI exhibiting the highest sensitivity to fine-grained temporal misalignments, the main alignment...

articles.title: Off-target posterior mass: A training-free diagnostic for fine-tuning spoken language diarization probes
articles.author: Zhuoyan Tao; Aditya Kommineni; Shrikanth Narayanan
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13430v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spoken Language Diarization (SLD) models provide frame-level language information of a speech recording. SLD modeling pipeline includes feature extraction from pre-trained speech models followed by clustering. Fine-tuning pre-trained speech models has shown performance gains for SLD with its magnitude being dataset dependent. Off-target Posterior Mass (OTPM), computed based on posterior language identification probabilities is proposed as a diagnostic metric to forecast performance gains from SLD fine-tuning. OTPM obtains positive correlation with probe gains, 0.56 on unseen synthetic bilingual data and 0.23 on real-world corpora. These results indicate promising potential of OTPM as a diagnostic metric for SLD.

articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13614v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generating long-form speech requires models to keep content, speaker identity, turn-taking, and expressive style consistent over time. Yet most open training corpora contain examples lasting only tens of seconds and open long-form benchmarks cover at most two speakers per recording. We introduce Emilia2, a 229K-hour multilingual dataset for controllable long-form speech generation. From in-the-wild data, Emilia2 constructs short utterances, single-speaker long-form speech, and multi-speaker dialogues, preserving transcripts, speaker identities, pauses, and acoustic transitions. Examples longer than five minutes account for 50.0% of single-speaker long-form hours and 66.8% of dialogue hours. To support expressive control, Emilia2 provides...

articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13811v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Antalia-2 Mini is a single-voice Turkish text-to-speech model with 7,620,931 parameters. It reads characters and produces 48 kHz audio at 41 times real time on an Apple M5 laptop CPU (2 threads). Its training audio came only from VoxCPM2 (the teacher), about 300 times larger, cloning one synthetic clip; automatic checks kept about 1,790 h. The teacher corrupts the start of a clip when the first word begins with \"o, the student learned this, and a spoken prefix we cut from the output hides it. articles.author: Sezgin Saygili; Emre Kaplaner; Oncel Ozgul; Fikri San Koktas
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13845v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present Alania-2, a Turkish text-to-speech (TTS) system with two built-in voices, voice design from text descriptions, and two kinds of voice cloning. Alania-2 is a 488M-parameter model with the VoxCPM architecture, which generates continuous audio latents with a diffusion head on top of a language-model backbone. We train it from scratch on 18,195 hours of Turkish speech, 90% of which is synthetic speech produced by a larger teacher model and filtered automatically. articles.title: AVCC: Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction with a Human Benchmark
articles.author: Haotian Qi; Gabriel Skantze
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13957v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: } Predicting who will speak next, and when, is a prerequisite for conversational agents and social robots that take turns without waiting for silence. Multiparty next-speaker prediction (NSP) has been studied on corpora with per-speaker sensors, each with its own event definitions. No public benchmark covers the single camera and microphone a robot has, and no model has been compared against how well people perform the same prediction. We turn AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of two- and three-speaker online conversation recorded with a single static camera and microphone, into a public NSP benchmark. We add a speaker-disjoint seven-video test partition with 865 hold and 865 shift events at mutual-silence gaps, word-level forced-aligned...

articles.author: Yuyue Wang; Xihua Wang; Xin Cheng; Yijing Chen; Ruihua Song
articles.summary: arXiv:2605.28063v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generating unified audio that naturally integrates speech and sounds from free-form text prompts remains challenging. For example, the prompt ``A fast drum roll ends with a cymbal crash, after which a man shouts: `Come on!'.'' describes several events that should appear in order and form a coherent recording rather than independent tracks that lack coherent temporal and semantic interactions. Current methods broadly follow two paradigms: pipeline methods couple separate text-to-sound and text-to-speech models, while unified models rely on a single generator that still requires structured, multi-field prompt inputs. articles.author: Thi Ngan Ha Do; Tingmin Wu; Alsharif Abuadbba; Kristen Moore
articles.summary: arXiv:2606.18738v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The advancement of speech generation technologies has made artificial speech increasingly realistic. Although modern classifiers achieve high accuracy in deepfake detection, they do not indicate where spoof cues appear in the spectrogram and what they imply acoustically, limiting their usefulness in forensic settings. Manual analysis of full spectrograms is resource-intensive, so evidence should narrow attention to the most diagnostic regions. Moreover, existing explainability methods have limited capabilities in connecting contextual attributes to localized evidence, making explanations harder to verify. To overcome this limitation, we propose GRIDEX, a pipeline that, given a detector-flagged spectrogram, generates forensic explanations...

articles.title: A Factorial Ablation of a Speech-to-SFT Pipeline: Differential Effects on Data Quality and Downstream Transfer
articles.author: Wonsup Shin; Jingu Kim
articles.summary: arXiv:2608.20394v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Industry pipelines that turn speech into supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data via multi-stage refinement are increasingly adopted but, to our knowledge, have not been publicly ablated stage-by-stage, leaving each stage's marginal value unknown. We design a production-ready speech-to-SFT pipeline in which transcript refinement (Phase 0) and SFT data quality refinement (Phase 2) are independently toggleable, yielding a 2x2 factorial design. For each condition, we generate QA-form SFT data from Korean medical and finance conference recordings and fine-tune 9 models (5 LLM families, 2.4B-70B); we evaluate with four cross-provider LLM judges, a blind six-expert human evaluation, and three downstream MCQA benchmarks. Our central finding is that,...

articles.title: Machine Hearing: Can Audio LLMs Generalize Beyond Human Auditory Perception?
articles.author: Liwei Liu; Jun Tao; Xingyuan Li; Xuenan Xu; Chen Zhang; Junyi Wang; Boya Zhang; Xiaoyu Yang; Zhen-Hua Ling; Wen Wu; Chao Zhang
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.10693v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multimodal LLMs have made remarkable progress in perceiving the physical world, while their perceptual scope remains largely human-centric, focusing on what humans can directly see or hear. This progress raises the prospect of perception beyond human limits, such as extending hearing to sounds that are inaudible to humans. More broadly, the physical world is full of waves, vibrations, and oscillations, only a small fraction of which are directly audible to humans. This invites the extension of multimodal LLMs toward a broader form of machine hearing, which remains largely underexplored. To investigate this direction, we introduce the Machine Hearing Benchmark (MHB), comprising 6,128 instances across 13 tasks and seven domains. MHB spans...

articles.title: XingChen-UniFE: A Unified Generative Speech Front-End via Complementary Acoustic-Semantic Modeling
articles.author: Kelan Kuang; Qihan Hu; Jian Kang; Jie Li; Yongxiang Li; Yi Liu
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.29164v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper presents XingChen-UniFE, a unified large audio language model (LALM) for general speech restoration (GSR) and target speaker extraction (TSE). The proposed model employs complementary semantic and acoustic representations through a dual-stream encoder, where a self-supervised learning model provides hierarchical semantic features and a learnable acoustic branch captures fine-grained structures from complex spectra. A bidirectional cross-attention module further facilitates information exchange between the two representations. The fused representation conditions the LALM for discrete speech token generation with task and speaker information. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both GSR and TSE and robust...

articles.title: Integrate the Reward, Don't Sample It: Window Likelihood for Interruptions and Backchannels in Full-Duplex Speech Models
articles.author: Guoqiang Hu; Lichao Zhang; Yizhou Peng; Yuhao Luo; Haifeng Hu; Zhongqian Sun; Wei Yang; Eng Siong Chng
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.35581v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: When a user talks over a full-duplex dialogue model, it must decide whether the user is interrupting (stop) or backchannelling (carry on). Post-training can improve this discrimination or change how readily it stops. In our GRPO runs the second dominates: no configuration lowers both error rates on more than one model, and two released checkpoints discriminate no better than their bases. We trace this partly to how the reward is estimated. The probability of stopping inside a short window is a known function of a few stop probabilities the policy emits, yet GRPO estimates it by sampling. A group of rollouts that all agree gives no gradient, even when all fail; the push on the stop threshold is strongest where the model is unsure,...

articles.title: Ninada: Sub-Clause Split-Graph VITS Streaming and Capability-Routed 24 kHz Speech Synthesis Across Twelve Scripts
articles.author: Hemanth HM
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.10035v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: End-to-end VITS text-to-speech models synthesize natural speech in a single forward pass, yet standard ONNX exports execute monolithically over an entire clause, delaying Time-To-First-Audio (TTFA) to several seconds and spiking activation memory. Client-side deployment across Indic scripts faces four further bottlenecks: 138.8 MB float32 checkpoints per language strain browser caches, mobile WebGPU stalls for 6-14 s compiling convolution shaders while still running slower than real time ($1.44\times$ RTF), small WebAssembly pthread pools stall at barriers on big-LITTLE mobile CPUs, and mobile Web Audio pipelines drop frames or mute output under AudioWorklet contention and iOS WKWebView rules. articles.title: Large-area Spatially Aligned Anchors
articles.author: Joni Vanherck; Brent Zoomers; Lode Jorissen; Isjtar Vandebroeck; Eric Joris; Nick Michiels
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.12912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extended Reality (XR) technologies, including Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR), offer immersive experiences merging digital content with the real world. Achieving precise spatial tracking over large areas is a critical challenge in XR development. This paper addresses the drift issue, caused by small errors accumulating over time leading to a discrepancy between the real and virtual worlds. Tackling this issue is crucial for co-located XR experiences where virtual and physical elements interact seamlessly. Building upon the locally accurate spatial anchors, we propose a solution that extends this accuracy to larger areas by exploiting an external, drift-corrected tracking method as a ground truth. articles.title: M\"obius Interaction Filtering: Order-Selective Spectral Regularization for Multimodal Humor Detection
articles.author: Jiahao Qin; Yiwen Wang
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.12913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal humor detection requires interpreting language, vocal delivery, and visual behavior jointly. Expressive fusion must also regulate how interactions of different orders enter the final judgment. We propose M\"obius Interaction Filtering (MoIF), which learns a modality-subset prediction function and imposes order-selective spectral regularization through its aggregation structure. Private temporal encoders and balanced reciprocal interaction construct supervised unimodal, bimodal, and trimodal predictors. Their uniform aggregate is exactly a M\"obius-domain filter with a geometrically decreasing interaction-order response. This formulation retains higher-order representations while regulating their contribution to prediction....

articles.title: One Rater to Score Them All: Frozen Large Language Model Anchoring for Video Quality of Experience
articles.author: Parsa Hassani Shariat Panahi; Amir H. Jalilvand; M. Hassan Najafi
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.12916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quality of Experience results for video streaming cannot be compared across studies, because public databases share neither test material nor subjects. This work introduces a common reference rater: an open-weights large language models with a fixed rubric and greedy decoding that scores the delivery events of every session and supplies the shared items that score equating requires. The rater is used without training, and it reads only the playback event log of startup delay, stalls and quality switches, which most delivery databases retain even when they share nothing else. articles.title: YTShorts-92K: An Interpretable Multimodal Dataset of YouTube Shorts
articles.author: Celian Charrin; Sidonie Abuzakuk; Art\'ur Vlaszov; N\'andor Birher; Roland Molontay
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Short-form video has become one of the dominant formats of online content, yet large-scale datasets enabling the analysis of what makes these videos successful remain limited. Existing resources often focus on post-publication popularity signals or rely on non-interpretable representations such as high-dimensional embeddings. Here, we introduce YTShorts-92K, a dataset of 92,654 YouTube Shorts collected from 345 creators and spanning 12 manually defined content categories. Each video is enriched with an interpretable multimodal feature set covering metadata, textual information, visual characteristics from frames and thumbnails, and cross-modal consistency measures. We describe the collection methodology, data cleaning process, and feature...

articles.title: DASWeave: Weaving Evidence across Speaking Conditions for Multimodal Depression, Anxiety, and Stress Screening
articles.author: Binyan Chen (University of Science and Technology of China; Hefei; China); Tong Pan (University of Science and Technology of China; Hefei; China); Yadong Liu (University of Science and Technology of China; Hefei; China); Xin Yun (University of Science and Technology of China; Hefei; China); Shangfei Wang (University of Science and Technology of China; Hefei; China)
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal screening for depression, anxiety, and stress in children and adolescents uses verbal and nonverbal behaviour. Most existing multimodal methods learn from a single recording or interview. Yet a participant's behaviour changes with the speaking condition, and these changes hold evidence that is invisible in a single recording. We propose DASWeave to bring this evidence into a neural network that encodes each response and then combines all responses of a participant. We train supervised trees to find which behavioural statistics matter for screening, both within each response and in how they change across conditions. We feed the tree outputs into the network both before and after this combination. We fine-tune a large language model...

articles.title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
articles.author: Yubo Cui; Xianchao Guan; Zheng Zhang
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.40309v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features constrains all directions equally, providing broad coverage without semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot...

articles.title: Token Importance-Aware Semantic Communication Enabled Robust Video Transmission
articles.author: Xiwen Zhang; Yubo Peng; Luping Xiang; Kun Yang
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.12928v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video applications are increasingly prevalent, yet their high data volume and temporal dependency make robust wireless transmission challenging under limited communication resources. To address this issue, we propose a token importance-aware semantic communication (Ti-SemCom) framework for bandwidth-efficient video transmission. Specifically, object and motion information is jointly extracted to identify communication-relevant regions, which are hierarchically associated with semantic tokens according to their importance. The transmitted tokens are then dynamically selected based on both token importance and the available bandwidth, prioritizing more informative video content under resource constraints. At the receiver, untransmitted...

articles.title: TIB: Sample-wise Tempered Information Bottleneck for Multimodal Attribution beyond Alignment Assumption
articles.author: Qiming Huang; Peixi Liu; Jianbo Jiao
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.12997v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multimodal (e.g. vision-language, in this work) attribution aims to interpret the models without access to ground-truth explanatory supervision. Existing multimodal attribution methods typically rely on paired modalities as proxy supervision, implicitly assuming that image-text pairs are semantically aligned. Information bottleneck (IB)-based attribution methods follow this general paradigm and instantiate it through a global sufficiency-compression objective. In realistic multimodal datasets, however, this assumption is frequently violated due to partial semantic misalignment and unreliable cross-modal correspondences. Through theoretical analysis, we show that, under such misalignment, information-bottleneck-based attribution objectives...

articles.title: Artifact Filtering versus Artifact-Compensated Training in JPEG to JPEG AI Recompression
articles.author: Igor Podtsepko; Yuriy Kim; Karam Mahfod; Evgeny Belyaev; Kristian Kirs; Jianping Lin; Ilya Papiev
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of recompression of images from JPEG to JPEG AI format. We show that direct recompression from JPEG to JPEG~AI trained on uncompressed images is accompanied by the preservation of the JPEG image artifacts in the resulting JPEG~AI image. In order to avoid it, we evaluate an approach where an artifacts removal neural network is first applied to the input JPEG image as an external pre-filter. However, in this case, the processing time is increased by 29 times. Therefore, we propose an artifact-compensated training for JPEG AI and show that it is able to combine pre-filtering against target distortions with efficient compression without increase in the processing time.

articles.title: Multimodal Judges Flag, Humans Decide: A Review-and-Edit Framework for AI-Generated Product Video Ads
articles.author: Anoubhav Agarwaal; Sukesh Perla; Karthikeyan Mohanraj; Susmita Ghose
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13178v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative pipelines can now turn every product page of an e-commerce catalog into a short video ad, but deciding whether such an ad is usable is not one good-or-bad call. We describe how we operationalized the review and editing of these ads so that both can keep pace with generation: reviewers go through each ad scene by scene and answer six questions, on the product, scene quality, pronunciation, script, sound and captions; judges built from vision-language, speech and language models file each finding under the matching question, and reviewers accept or reject each finding and add what the judges missed. Each confirmed issue then opens an edit tool matched to it. The questions and the routing from a finding to its fix do not depend on...

articles.title: ABRR: Transforming Temporal Sentence Grounding with Wasserstein-Adaptive Refinement and Precision Ranking
articles.author: Xiang Fang; Wanlong Fang; Junhao Dong; Daizong Liu
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13310v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Temporal Sentence Grounding (TSG) aims to localize temporal segments in untrimmed videos that correspond to natural language queries, a critical task for video understanding with applications in video retrieval, summarization, and human-computer interaction. Despite significant progress driven by transformer-based models, existing TSG methods suffer from two key limitations: quantization errors due to temporal downsampling, which misalign segment boundaries, and suboptimal ranking of predictions based on semantic matching rather than localization precision. To address these challenges, we propose the Adaptive Boundary Refinement and Ranking (ABRR) framework, a novel, model-agnostic post-processing approach that enhances the performance of...

articles.title: Joint Activation and Weight Quantization for Learned Image Compression
articles.author: Yile Tu; Heming Sun
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13707v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) models achieve competitive rate-distortion performance with increasingly large networks, making network quantization important for efficient deployment. Directly quantizing LIC models remains difficult in post-training quantization (PTQ) because compression performance is highly sensitive to quantization noise. Existing methods typically focus on optimizing either the weights or the activations, resulting in substantial rate-distortion degradation. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-stage pipeline that uses SmoothQuant to balance activation and weight ranges, followed by GPTQ to adapt the transformed weights. The proposed joint search framework optimizes the balancing transformation and adapted...

articles.title: Data Quality Challenges in Multimodal Tourism Recommender Systems
articles.author: Zehui Wang, Wolfram H\"opken, Dietmar Jannach
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13972v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern recommender systems increasingly consider diverse data modalities to enhance model performance. However, the quality of the underlying multimodal data (e.g. data from social media platforms) has received limited attention so far. Focusing on tourism recommendation, we examine real-world challenges encountered when using datasets from Yelp and Instagram. Issues include noise from fake reviews, hallucinated content from LLMs, modality contradictions, and demographic bias. We outline future directions such as quality-aware fusion, structured and controlled LLM-based content generation to reduce hallucinations, and user group differentiation to improve the robustness and reliability of multimodal recommendation systems.

articles.title: LUMIR: Decoupled Multimodal Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Data for Next-POI Recommendation
articles.author: Zehui Wang, Wolfram H\"opken, Dietmar Jannach
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As multimodal tourism-related information collected from heterogeneous data sources has become increasingly available, learning effective representations has attracted attention for improving recommendation performance. Existing approaches often tightly couple multimodal fusion with the architecture and optimization objective of a specific downstream model, which limits the generality and reusability of the learned representations. To address these limitations, we propose LUMIR, a decoupled multimodal representation learning framework based on contrastive learning. Multimodal information collected from heterogeneous data sources is first semantically unified into a shared textual representation space using large language models (LLMs). An...

articles.title: Smiling Regulates Emotion During Traumatic Recollection
articles.author: Marcus Ma, Emily Zhou, Leonard Ludwig, Julia H\"orath, Christina Winkler, Kleanthis Avramidis, Tiantian Feng, Gabor Mihaly Toth, Alina Bothe, Shrikanth Narayanan
articles.summary: arXiv:2604.19019v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study when, where, and why 978 Holocaust survivors smile in video testimonies. We create an automatic smile detection model from facial features with an F1 of 85% and annotate detected smiles under two established taxonomies of smiling. We produce narrative features on 1,083,417 transcript sentences as well as emotional valence from three different modalities: audio, eye gaze, and text transcript. Smiling rates are associated with specific semantic topics, narrative structures, and temporal syntaxes across the corpus. Smiles often occur during periods of intense negative affect and we find negative-affect smiles are associated with more positive subsequent valence trajectories across all three modalities. articles.title: Unified Synthesis of Compositional Speech and Sound from Free-Form Text Prompts
articles.author: Yuyue Wang; Xihua Wang; Xin Cheng; Yijing Chen; Ruihua Song
articles.summary: arXiv:2605.28063v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Generating unified audio that naturally integrates speech and sounds from free-form text prompts remains challenging. For example, the prompt ``A fast drum roll ends with a cymbal crash, after which a man shouts: `Come on!'.'' describes several events that should appear in order and form a coherent recording rather than independent tracks that lack coherent temporal and semantic interactions. Current methods broadly follow two paradigms: pipeline methods couple separate text-to-sound and text-to-speech models, while unified models rely on a single generator that still requires structured, multi-field prompt inputs. Both paradigms require upstream prompt decomposition or rewriting, limiting free-form flexibility and risking...

articles.title: Off-target posterior mass: A training-free diagnostic for fine-tuning spoken language diarization probes
articles.author: Zhuoyan Tao; Aditya Kommineni; Shrikanth Narayanan
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spoken Language Diarization (SLD) models provide frame-level language information of a speech recording. SLD modeling pipeline includes feature extraction from pre-trained speech models followed by clustering. Fine-tuning pre-trained speech models has shown performance gains for SLD with its magnitude being dataset dependent. Off-target Posterior Mass (OTPM), computed based on posterior language identification probabilities is proposed as a diagnostic metric to forecast performance gains from SLD fine-tuning. OTPM obtains positive correlation with probe gains, 0.56 on unseen synthetic bilingual data and 0.23 on real-world corpora. These results indicate promising potential of OTPM as a diagnostic metric for SLD.

articles.title: Emilia2: A Large-Scale Dataset for Controllable Long-Form Speech Generation
articles.author: Qinke Ni; Dekun Chen; Junwen Qiu; Huan Liao; Xu Li; Xingwen Han; Wan Lin; Kunyu Feng; Yuxiang Wang; Yusheng Mu; Chaoren Wang; Yingda Shen; Mingjie Chen; Haolong Zheng; Xulin Fan; Mark A. Hasegawa-Johnson; Zhizheng Wu
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generating long-form speech requires models to keep content, speaker identity, turn-taking, and expressive style consistent over time. Yet most open training corpora contain examples lasting only tens of seconds and open long-form benchmarks cover at most two speakers per recording. We introduce Emilia2, a 229K-hour multilingual dataset for controllable long-form speech generation. From in-the-wild data, Emilia2 constructs short utterances, single-speaker long-form speech, and multi-speaker dialogues, preserving transcripts, speaker identities, pauses, and acoustic transitions. articles.title: Walrus Technical Report
articles.author: Alkis Koudounas; Osamu Take; Hayato Futami; Quentin Jodelet; Emiru Tsunoo
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13689v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present Walrus, a unified 8B speech-and-audio foundation model handling speech recognition (including code-switching and multi-talker speech), speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, text-to-speech, emotion recognition, audio captioning, and general audio understanding. Our main contribution is not a new architecture but a data-centric training recipe; we use a standard decoder-only backbone initialized from Gemma 4, so that gains can be traced to the data. For speech generation, Walrus predicts low-bitrate discrete speech tokens, and a lightweight token-to-waveform decoder converts them into high-fidelity audio. articles.title: DialInstruct-TTS: Interactive Expressive Speech Generation via Multi-Turn Dialogue with Fine-Grained Temporal Control
articles.author: Wangzixi Zhou; Bagus Tris Atmaja; Sakriani Sakti
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing instruction-based TTS systems primarily support one-shot, utterance-level control, where a single instruction determines the speaking style of an entire utterance. As a result, even minor refinements require rewriting the instruction and regenerating the full utterance, limiting fine-grained interactive control. We propose DialInstruct-TTS, an interactive multi-turn expressive TTS framework that enables users to iteratively refine generated speech through natural-language dialogue until the desired style is achieved. articles.title: Passive ladder-network representation of the radiation impedance of a spherical cap on a rigid sphere
articles.author: Ronald M. Aarts
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14016v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A loudspeaker in a closed box is modeled as a rigid sphere with an axially moving cap. For an axisymmetric cone-velocity profile, its radiation impedance is written as a network. Each spherical-harmonic mode has an impedance rational in frequency, realized exactly as a finite passive ladder of masses and compliances terminated in a resistance. Ideal transformers set by Legendre coefficients couple these ladders; truncated modes reduce to a residual mass. Despite the different geometry, the impedance resembles that of a baffled piston but, at equal volume velocity, has half its low-frequency resistance and about three quarters of its radiation mass.

articles.title: ESDCodec: Ultra-Low Bitrate Speech Codec with Enhanced Semantic Disentanglement and Subband Decoding
articles.author: Nan Xu; Kecan Mao; Xin Gu; Yi Zhao; Zhi Gong
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite recent advances in neural speech codecs, achieving highfidelity speech reconstruction at low bitrates remains a formidable challenge. To address this limitation, we propose ESDCodec, a speech codec that integrates a thoroughly enhanced semantic quantizer and a conditioned decoder network. Specifically, we employ a randomly initialized and frozen codebook, followed by a lightweight projector, to encode semantic details entirely within a linear space while enhancing codebook utilization. To further improve perceptual quality, we design a condition network that explicitly injects prior subband knowledge into the upsampling decoder. articles.title: GigaEdge Spench: An SDK for Practical Streaming Speech Enhancement
articles.author: Artem Sokolov; Artem Khaidarov; Yana Lysova; Alexander Gladkikh; Vitaliy Yulis
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13243v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present GigaEdge Spench, an open-source SDK for streaming speech enhancement on CPU servers, mobile devices, and in browsers. Applications can build enhancement channels from neural denoising, normalization and dynamics blocks, sample-rate conversion, and acoustic echo cancellation where supported. These stages can be combined, while normalization can also run without a neural model. The release includes an 8 kHz INT8 denoiser and discriminative and hybrid 48 kHz FP32 models. A shared C++ core supports ONNX Runtime and TensorFlow Lite through native interfaces, Android and iOS SDKs, and WebAssembly integration. articles.title: On the information rate of phones, syllables and words
articles.author: Herman Kamper
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.13990v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Which linguistic units minimise the bitrate required to encode speech content: phones, syllables, words, maybe larger units, or something in between? This question has implications for the development of speech and language systems and theories of human language processing. Using a transcribed corpus of 960 hours of English audiobooks, I compare the information rates of phones, syllables, words, multi-word combinations and intermediate tokenisations. While all units are equivalent under a perfect language model, it makes sense to compare these under limited modelling budgets; I use $n$-gram and transformer language models. articles.title: Spatio-Temporal Calibration of a Vehicle-Mounted Microphone Array for Autonomous Driving
articles.author: Marvin Seegert; Richard Taupitz; Korbinian Moller; Johannes Betz
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14003v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Microphones let an autonomous vehicle sense into areas its cameras and LiDAR cannot see, by picking up the sound that other traffic participants emit. Locating those sources and fusing them with the visual perception requires the microphone array to be calibrated and registered relative to the vehicle's other sensors. Existing calibration methods assume small, unobstructed indoor rigs, whereas a vehicle body casts an acoustic shadow that straight-line propagation cannot represent, and to our knowledge no calibration of an array distributed around a vehicle has been reported. articles.title: Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters
articles.author: Sahil Mahendrakar
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14421v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. articles.title: Assessing Alignment in Automatic Piano Transcription Datasets: A Benchmark for Scoring Methods
articles.author: Lucas de Souza Brand\~ao; Lucas Gris; Joaquim Cavalcante; Chukwuemeka Nkama; Andrea Poltronieri
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.14443v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic Music Transcription (AMT) relies on paired audio--MIDI datasets, implicitly assuming near-perfect temporal alignment. However, widely used piano datasets have been shown to contain alignment errors that may bias model evaluation and training. We propose a framework for evaluating audio--MIDI alignment scoring methods through controlled temporal, pitch, and structural MIDI corruptions. We also introduce STI, a scoring method built on AMT models, and benchmark it against existing alignment scoring approaches. articles.title: AI 生成视频何时才能告别“抽卡”？藏在高效生成背后的返工与成本难题
articles.summary: 原创 林绮蓓 2026-11-11 12:38 北京 多模态AI加速内容创作，距离一次成型还有多远？ 作者｜林绮蓓 编辑｜蔡芳芳 用 AI 生成一段视频，可能只需要几分钟。但要让它真正符合创作者的要求，往往还得一遍遍地尝试。在 AI 视频制作中，这种反复生成、筛选的过程被形象地称为 “抽卡”。腾讯云 WAND 多模态应用负责人朱琳在采访中提到：按照行业经验，制作一部 AI 短漫剧，从分镜到成片，过程中可能需要大约十次生成尝试，才能得到一次满意的效果。这种落差并不仅仅发生在视频领域，它揭示了当下 AI 创作中统一的现实矛盾：AI 生成内容的速度越来越快，创作者却未必能同样快速地获得自己真正想要的作品。 生成内容的门槛降低了，反复尝试的代价却不小。每一次“抽卡”，不仅意味着额外的模型调用和等待，还可能带来人工筛选、修改和返工成本。在 10 月 30 日举行的腾讯全球数字生态大会多模态应用专场及会后的媒体采访中，来自腾讯云、智象未来等企业的嘉宾，围绕这一问题分享了各自在实际内容生产中遇到的困难与技术探索。1 AI 能生成好画面，为什么还是难以一次性交付？ 在电商领域，商家常常需要借助 AI 为商品更换背景、调整光影，同时确保商品的形状、颜色和品牌标识不发生改变。此外，同一件商品还需要生成主图、卖点图、场景图等多种素材。这意味着，模型不仅要生成符合要求的画面，还要在批量生成过程中保持商品特征的准确性和一致性。视频制作则更复杂。单个镜头可能已经足够逼真，但放进连续叙事中，还需要保证角色形象、人物动作、空间关系和镜头衔接的一致性。一个镜头出现偏差，就可能影响前后内容的连续性。今年 9 月发表的研究论文 《Better Call CineCrew: Consistent Ultra-Long Narrative-to-Film Generation》...

articles.title: 当 AI 开始像员工一样上岗，企业还差什么？| 极客时间企业版
articles.summary: InfoQ 2026-11-11 12:38 北京 今年，AI 办公智能体点燃了市场，「数字员工」开始成为越来越多企业讨论的高频词。人们期待 AI 不只回答问题，而是能像人类员工一样理解任务、调用工具、接入系统、交付结果。但真走到上岗这一步，企业发现面对的远不只是技术问题：AI 能不能像员工一样干活？该被授予哪些权限？产出怎么评价、责任怎么界定？在出行、零售、数据服务等行业的实践中，一批先行企业已经交出了大量一线答案。本文把这些实践整理成 6 个判断，希望能帮你重新审视自己的 AI 能力建设。从「能对话」到「能上岗」，中间隔着一条分水岭企业在用 AI 这件事上，大致会经历三个阶段：「能对话」→「能干活」→「能上岗」。「能对话」大部分企业已经做到——通过知识库和检索增强，让 AI 的回答符合行业需要。这是 2024 到 2025 年大家普遍在补的课。「能干活」是很多企业正在投入的方向：从辅助对话，到真正完成一个闭环任务。这里有两类做法：一类是自上而下搭一个 AI 工作台，让各部门在上面生成各种智能体提效；另一类是自下而上，员工从具体任务出发跑通一个智能体，再沉淀成可复用的经验包。关键在于真实场景、真实任务，而不是 demo。再往前，才是「能上岗」的数字员工。它要在 AI 的基础上叠加机制：在规定的范围内自主完成任务，涉及系统对接、权限授予、安全保障，还要能像人类员工一样被管理和考核。这一步考验的不只是技术，更是流程与制度。从「能对话」到「能上岗」，中间隔的不是模型能力，而是企业的组织信任。数字员工的两道门槛：自主化与自进化有家智慧停车企业把「数字员工」的标准提炼成两个词，值得所有企业参考。第一，自主化。如果 AI 交付的产物还要经过人来审核一道，它还不算真正的数字员工，只停留在对话阶段。数字员工产出的结果要能直接作用于生产。第二，自进化。如果 AI...

articles.summary: 机器之心 2026-11-11 12:12 湖北 让开发者能够组合、替换和比较不同的进化策略，复用已有的任务执行、评测和版本管理能力。 GEAR 可以让研究者像使用 Scikit-learn 一样模块化构建 RSI 算法。它将采样、候选评测和多样性管理所需的算法模块与并行推理等测评设施组织起来，使得 RSI 算法能够快速搭建、比较和复用。基于 GEPA（Genetic-Pareto）算法改进的实验结果证明，GEAR 调优的 Agent 在营销、客服和代码任务上均取得显著提升。一、研究意义、亮点与主要结果：打造 Scikit-learn 式的模块化 RSI 框架来自 Imperial College London、Duke 等机构的研究者提出开源框架 GEAR，希望为递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement，RSI）提供一套通用工具箱。它的定位可以概括为 toolkits for RSI：让开发者能够组合、替换和比较不同的进化策略，复用已有的任务执行、评测和版本管理能力。论文：GEAR: An Open General Evolutionary Architecture for Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agent Harness，2026 年 10 月 26 日预印本。论文作者：Yehui Tang、Guanqi Zhu、Shao-Jun Xia、Xin Chen、Mengzhe Geng、Hongyang Du、Yuhao Tang。项目主页：rsi-gear.github.io开源代码：github.com/rsi-gear/gear论文：https://huggingface.co/spaces/WizardTY/GEARGEAR...

articles.title: 做了个 AI 功能，成本是不是只有 API 费用？
articles.summary: 原创 AI产品经理老猫 2026-11-11 12:03 广东 很多产品经理只看到了冰山一角。 很多产品经理看一眼API账单，就觉得AI成本控制得不错。其实API费只是最小的一块——标注、人工兜底、知识库维护加起来，通常是API费的3到5倍。Klarna裁掉700人又招回400人的教训就在眼前：把四项成本算清楚，再决定要不要做AI。———— / BEGIN / ————我见过不少产品经理，大部分人只在心里默认"成本 = API 费"。看一眼账单上的 API 费，就觉得"成本控制得还可以"。其实呢，API 费只是整个成本里最小的那一部分。数据标注要投一笔、人工审核要专人看守、知识库要不断维护、流程要不断调整、坏案例要人工兜底……这些加起来，远远超过了 API 费。接下来我把 AI 功能的成本拆成四项，告诉你每一项到底要花多少钱、怎么避坑。成本一：API 调用费——你唯一能看见的成本最简单的算法是：每天会话数 × 平均单条 Token 数 × 单位价格比如：日均 1000 会话平均每条对话 400 个 Token（输入200，输出200）使用 Claude，输入 0.3 元/百万 Token，输出 1.2 元/百万 Token那么：1000 × (200 × 0.3/100 万 + 200 × 1.2/100 万) ≈ 30 块/天，月成本 900 块但这只是理想情况。实际上，你的输出 Token 往往比预期多（因为 Prompt 不够精准），所以真实成本通常是预估的 1.5-2 倍。坑一：输出 Token 比输入贵 4 倍以 DeepSeek 为例，输入是 2 元每百万 Token，输出是 8 元。原因很简单：输入可以并行处理，输出得一个一个生成，所以费用也高。这就意味着，你看似省钱的操作，其实不一定省。比如你想"缩短 Prompt"来省输入...

articles.summary: 上周五团建，部门聚餐的时候聊到年龄，我突然来了兴致，打开飞书的组织架构，把我们整个前端部门的人头捋了一遍。 我们部门加上我一共 38 个人。我一个一个数，35 岁以上的，包括我自己，只有 2 个😢。 另一个是我们组的测试转前端的老哥，今年 37，去年刚从测试岗转过来写 Vue，算是公司内部的老人，靠着对业务的熟悉度留了下来。 剩下 36 个人，清一色 95 后，甚至有好几个 00 后。最年轻的一个实习生，2004 年的。我看到他工牌上的出生年份时，愣了好一会儿。 那顿饭我吃得不太有味道。我突然意识到：我在这个部门里，已经是绝对意义上的老人了 🤔。 35 岁以上的前端，到底去哪了？ 这个问题我后来认真想了很久，也私下问了不少同行朋友。 答案其实没那么复杂。 转管理了 这是最主流的路径。35 岁左右的前端，如果还在一线写代码，大概率会被 HR 和老板反复暗示：你是不是该带团队了。不管你愿不愿意，公司的晋升体系就是这么设计的——技术序列到了一定级别就封顶，想继续涨薪，要么转管理，要么走专家路线。 但说实话，国内大部分公司的所谓技术专家路线，不过是给你换了个 Title，实际工作内容跟以前一模一样，甚至更尴尬——你既没有管理权，也没有决策权，就是一个挂着高级别的高级螺丝钉。 所以很多人被迫选了管理。带团队之后，代码写得越来越少，技术手感越来越生疏。三年后回头一看，自己已经不太敢面试纯技术岗了 😖。 被优化了 这个词在国内互联网已经被用烂了，但它确实是最真实的去向之一。 35 岁在很多公司的 HR 系统里，就是一条隐形的红线。不是说到了 35 岁就立刻被裁，而是一旦遇上组织调整、业务收缩、或者新来的领导要换自己人，35 岁以上的员工永远是第一批被放进名单的。 原因很简单：贵！ 一个工作十年的前端，月薪可能在 30K 到 45K。同样的活，招两个三年经验的 95 后，一个人...

articles.summary: 即使是让 Agent 操作软件，但人还是要看结果的，所以现在软件设计重心变成了怎么让人更好的验收。举几个 Claude Artifacts 设计的好的地方：1. 多人协作 -> 人和 Agent 协作以前的软件比如 Google Docs、Figma 会强调人和人之间的协作，你也可以很方便的看到谁在操作、操作的历史。而在 Artifacts 里面，你能看到 Agent 正在做的操作，也能看到 Agent 所有的操作历史。你可以在设计稿里面添加评论告诉 Agent 怎么改，Agent 改完还会回复你的评论让你再看看。2. 人直接操作 -> 标记和评论以前软件是人操作为主，所以要考虑人怎么用，但是很多操作是真的很复杂，UI 操作也只能设计的很复杂。举个例子来说，传统视频剪辑软件，我要把某一个时间段静音的视频剪掉，我就只能通过有一个 Timeline，有专门的带 Waveform（波形）的音频 track，然后用户通过放大 Timeline 的波形去甄别出来哪里是没声音的，然后手动打上标记，最后再点击删除把标记的一段删除掉。这个场景换到 Claude Motion，它只有一个很简单的代表时间和场景的 Timeline，需要剪辑其中一段，只要大致框线一个时间段出来，然后写一条评论发给 Claude：帮我把这一段视频中静音的部分剪掉，然后 Claude 就会自己去找出来静音部分去删除，完全不需要你去放大 Timeline 去标记这些繁琐的操作。3. 人主导 -> Agent 采访人之后实施传统软件都是你自己想清楚了再去软件上实施，就像写 PPT/Slides，得你自己有想法才能写的出来，遥想当年要写一个 PPT 打开 PowerPoint 半天不知道写点啥好。现在你使用 Claude Design 或者 Claude...

articles.title: 基于本体的AI数据研发落地：淘宝行业经营分析实战
articles.summary: 左文雯 张哲旸 2026-11-11 10:36 浙江 把业务规则变成AI可读、可追溯的结构化知识。为AI SQL Coding提供精确输入。 AI 写 SQL，快不等于能交付。在阿里的业务体系中，一个经营分析需求往往要关联数十甚至上百张表，同名字段在不同场景下含义不同，指标口径还会随业务迭代不断变化。更棘手的是，大量业务规则从没写进文档，只存在于历史生产代码和资深研发的经验里。新人要花几个月才能上手，团队的经验也很难复制。由于缺少对业务知识的了解，当大模型开始帮忙写 SQL时，这个问题就变得突出。为此，我们引入本体（Ontology），从生产代码中自动抽取隐性的业务规则，把它们变成 AI 可读、可追溯的结构化知识。为 AI SQL Coding 提供精确输入。AI 生成 SQL 的三类典型错误当大模型作为辅助开发工具进入数据开发场景，矛盾变得突出：模型的代码生成速度远超人类，但做出正确判断所需的业务知识，它无从获取。▐1.1 一个看似简单的需求以一个常见需求为例：业务方说「帮我查一下上月各品类的 top 品牌成交额及同比数据。」需求只有一句话，看上去也不复杂。通用大模型几秒就能生成一段语法完整的 SQL，SELECT、FROM、WHERE、GROUP BY 结构齐全，逻辑通顺。但对照需求细看，问题就会暴露：品类下的品牌数据该从哪张表取？成交额对应哪个字段、是否包含退款？同比的口径又是什么？这些判断在 SQL 里没有标准答案。研发凭经验秒懂，模型只能猜。▐1.2 三类高频错误真实开发中上述问题很常见，我们把通用 AI 的生成错误归纳为三类：选错表。同一数据域下常有明细表、汇总表、快照表等十余张相似表，粒度各不相同。AI 分不清这些表之间的区别，容易选一张看着对实则不满足需求的表。用错字段。同名字段在不同表中含义不同，同一含义在不同表中对应的字段名也不同。AI...

articles.summary: Meta 如何用 AI 构建 Forum：让 Agent 不只写代码，还能验证自己是否做完Forum 是 Meta 面向 Facebook 小组推出的独立应用，不是工程平台。@Meta_Engineers 这篇博客复盘了一个小团队如何借助 Agent 从零开发产品。核心不再是生成更多代码，是让规划、实现、测试和修正持续运转，人负责目标、关键判断与上线批准。engineering.fb.com/2026/10/15/ml-…从逐步指挥，转向监督完整执行过程团队追求的是：Agent 自己完成多轮开发，工程师在偏离目标时介入，而不是每一步都下指令。但作者明确说，这仍是推进中的方向，并非所有阶段都已实现。关键是把“做完”的标准接进执行过程：需求写成精确、机器可读的规格；构建结果、单元测试和界面对照检查持续反馈给 Agent；导航 Agent 操作正在运行的应用，执行回归验证。提交审查时，还要附上构建、测试结果和验证录像。能编译并不代表完成，每项上线仍需工程师批准。收益不只来自模型，更来自代码和工具改造团队把反复出现的纠正写进 Rules，用 Skills 固化操作，通过 Commands 串联复现、修复和审查，再用 Hooks 自动触发检查。更值得注意的是，他们认为最大收益来自改造代码和工具，而非反复调整提示词：让模块结构更清楚，必要时减少复用；让 Agent 直接读取模拟器的实时界面层级，而不是依赖文字描述。团队用八周实现了与 Facebook Groups 的核心功能对等；开发阶段的压力测试还帮助发现内存问题，修复后内存占用和缺页次数约减半。但文章未披露团队人数、完整功能范围及测试口径，也没有宣布这套工程系统开源。Engineering at Meta@Meta_Engineers🧠Forum, Meta’s new standalone Groups app, was...

articles.title: 300 块的索尼复古耳机，没降噪不隔音，为什么还是卖爆了？
articles.author: 郑廷旭
articles.summary: 在美剧《怪奇物语》第四季里，Max 戴着随身听、靠着 Kate Bush 那首《Running Up That Hill》逃离险境的画面，曾掀起过一轮漫长的复古狂欢。 图｜索尼 MDR-3R 怪奇物语联名款，红色耳垫配合极简复古框架 镜头里那副纤细的双金属横梁、挂着鲜亮橙色海绵垫的小耳机，正是这场视觉回潮的标志。 但你可能不知道，它在现实世界里有一个具体到无聊的名字——索尼 MDR-3L2。 1979 年，它作为初代 Walkman TPS-L2 的原装附赠耳机登场，和那台蓝银相间的磁带机一起，第一次把「听音乐」这件事带出了客厅。年轻人走在街头时，第一次拥有了私人 BGM。 图｜史密森尼国家设计博物馆馆藏的 1979 年初代 Walkman TPS-L2，以及当时原装附带的 MDR-3L2 耳机 距离初代问世近半个世纪，索尼借着《怪奇物语》最终季的热度，让这款老产品以新的面貌再次回归，定名 MDR-3R。 没有大型发布会，也没有铺天盖地的声学宣传，但它刚在海外官网上架，普通版与联名版就迅速被抢购一空。 图｜索尼 在日本市场，两款开放定价的耳机被预估在含税 8000 日元和 10000 日元左右（约合人民币 370 元至 460 元），中国香港普通版建议零售价定在 379 港币。 由于海外发售初期国内暂无货源，二级市场和代购渠道的价格一度被炒高了近一倍，活脱脱把一副百元级入门耳机炒成了「理财产品」。 不过，这场溢价狂欢大概率维持不了几天。 就在这两天，索尼中国正式放出了一张蓝橙撞色的官方海报，配上「新声，如故」的文案，直接定档 11 月 17 日中午 12:00。国行版本的到来，基本宣告了二级市场加价泡沫的终结。 图｜索尼中国 复古的外观，几乎跟 47 年前如出一辙。唯一不同的，是线的另一端，换成了一枚如今随处可见的 Type-C 接口。 1979 年的壳，2026 年的线...

articles.author: meng shao (@shao__meng)
articles.summary: Airbnb 开源内部使用的工作流引擎 Skipper：把可恢复的工作流嵌进服务，不必另建编排集群；面向 Java、Kotlin 服务，解决多步业务中常见的问题：执行到一半进程崩溃、下游暂时失败，流程怎样继续，而不是从头盲目重做。开源地址：github.com/airbnb/skipper核心机制：执行在服务里，进度存进数据库Skipper 作为库嵌入现有服务，运行时和调度器随服务一起部署，不需要独立的工作流编排集群。多个服务副本共享数据库，用租约协调任务；某个副本失败后，其他副本可以接管。恢复时，它会从头重放工作流方法，但已持久化的动作直接返回保存结果，不必重新执行。流程也能暂停等待信号或定时器，不持续占用线程。因此，它不只是串联函数的工具，而是具备持久化与故障恢复能力的执行引擎。最重要的边界：可恢复，不等于绝不重复Skipper 不能保证下游操作只发生一次。 默认情况下，部分检查点会批量写入；落盘前崩溃，已经完成的动作可能再次执行。即使立即保存，下游调用与检查点也不是一个原子事务。因此，支付、发券等操作仍需开发者保证幂等，避免重复调用产生重复结果。开源版目前提供 MySQL、SQLite 适配器，多实例生产部署建议用 MySQL；Postgres、DynamoDB 仍在规划。Airbnb 此前自报，内部已覆盖 15 个以上用例，峰值达到每秒 1 万个工作流，但该峰值使用 DynamoDB，不能直接视为当前开源版的性能指标。Airbnb Engineering@AirbnbEngSkipper is now open source! 🎉 Explore Airbnb’s embedded workflow engine, now available to developers under the Apache 2.0 license on GitHub....

articles.title: AI 10分钟写完代码，你2小时还在验？用验收Agent补上最后一公里
articles.summary: 原创 吴思 2026-11-11 08:45 中国澳门 关注腾讯云开发者，一手技术干货提前解锁👇开发者公众号专属群聊扫码加入获取更多一手教程、科技前沿报告当 AI 大幅提升代码生成效率后，一个新的问题也慢慢浮现：代码写得更快了，却更难判断它是否真的能用。光靠静态 Review 很难确认 AI 生成的代码是否满足需求。于是，我们在代码生成之后再向后多做一步：让 AI 真实调用接口，并结合接口返回、业务状态、日志、DB 等信息，逐层验证代码是否真正实现了需求。本文将介绍如何通过真实执行和多层证据，让代码验收从“看代码”走向“看结果”，也让我们对 AI 生成的代码多一些信心。01业务背景与痛点在医疗相关业务的研发过程中，我们一直在探索 AI 如何参与研发全流程，减少需求开发中的重复工作和人工介入。围绕这个方向，我们自建了一个 OPT（One Person Team）平台。OPT 平台是以 CodeBuddy 等 CLI 为底层运行时打造的人与 Agent 协同工作的平台，通过多个 Agent 组成的小队，可以协同完成需求分析、规划、开发等工作，让 AI 从辅助编码参与到完整的需求交付中。随着 AI 参与得越来越深，后端需求开发的节奏也发生了明显变化。现在，很多需求分析、方案设计和编码的工作都可以交给 AI 完成，“把代码生产出来”正在变得越来越容易。但另一个问题也变得更加突出：代码写得更快了，却更难快速判断它是否真的能用。后端代码的采纳和验收并不等于“代码已生成”，也不等于“接口能调通”，往往涉及复杂的业务规则和上下游流程。一个接口返回 200，只能说明它在当前参数下完成了一次调用；但需求逻辑是否正确、边界条件是否覆盖、老数据是否兼容、异步任务是否生效，以及日志和数据库状态是否符合预期，仍然需要进一步验证。也就是说，AI...

articles.author: 山宗
articles.summary: AI 大模型的发布节奏已经快到让人应接不暇。 就在刚刚，Google DeepMind 正式宣布，旗下最新旗舰模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 正式面向开发者、企业、科研人员及普通消费者提供服务。 Carbon 是目前 Gemini 家族综合能力最强的公开上线模型，尤其擅长复杂编程、网络安全、科学推理，以及需要长时间执行的多智能体任务。 图｜官方博客 https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-carbon-now-available/ 两周前，谷歌已经通过 Fairwind 计划向部分网络安全防御人员开放 Carbon，如今进一步扩大了使用范围。 与此前发布的 Gemini 4 Argon 相比，Carbon 主要面向复杂软件工程、跨领域研究等高难度任务，能够消耗更多 Token 进行深入推理、反复验证和错误修正，而 Argon 继续承担大多数日常编程和知识工作。 在 CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity WANDR 和 Zapier AutomationBench 三项基准测试中，Carbon 均排名第一，单任务成本比表现次优的外部竞争模型低了一半以上。 价格方面，Carbon 的 API 优惠价格与 Argon 相同，每百万输入 Token 为 2 美元，每百万输出 Token 为 10 美元，12 月 1 日起将分别调整至 4 美元和 20 美元。 图｜ https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing 一句话召唤 AI 团队，连夜造出完整游戏 Gemini 4 Carbon 的一项重要升级，是能够协调多个 AI Agent，共同完成大型工程项目。 谷歌为此在 AI 编程平台 Google...

articles.summary: 💾Preston Stewart is a West Point graduate and Afghanistan veteran who covers the Ukraine war extensively on his YouTube channel, his podcast called War and Conflict, and his newsletter called Defense Tech News. Michael Kofman is a world-class military analyst specializing in the Russian and Ukrainian militaries. He is a senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment and he hosts The Russia Contingency podcast on the War on the Rocks platform. articles.summary: 挠头要不我给大家开个课吧姬正@letsjaaaaam一开始我也这么想的，后来知道原理其实很简单.这类 personal agent 其实是把「给用户发消息」本身设计成一个 Tool，比方说设计成一个 send message tool，把 message 放到参数里面。这样 Agent 调用完之后， Agent 还可以继续工作。具体原理其实也可以看这两个实现，写的都很清楚。github.com/OpenHands/soft…weisu.io/articles/decod…🔗 View Quoted Tweet💬14🔄0❤️45👀10288📊21⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
